selection.FREEZE01_required: Resolve representative baseline plus prototype within at most three confirmation arms; do not drop a strong comparator silently.
selection.scope: Operational development choice only. Instrumented six-sample timing is not isolated formal latency. Remaining Pareto contenders are not statistically eliminated.
selection.selection_rule: lowest design FER; ties by engineering mean latency then lexical ID

selection_protocol: coded FER/isolated latency Pareto; default lowest FER within cost; if paired interval cannot separate top cost-class contenders retain top two for confirmation; no inference from a single point
